exact: N-retinylidene-phosphatidylethanolamine flippase activity (exoplasmic to cytosolic leaflet)

definition: Catalysis of the movement of N-retinylidene-N-retinylphosphatidylethanolamine from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP.
label: N-retinylidene-phosphatidylethanolamine flippase activity
